edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: "Fail-closed" already means the checks are not open, so "rather than open" adds nothing.

edits.original: The playbook change significantly reduces mean time to contain.
edits.reason: This sentence repeats the previous one, which already gives the drop from 18 hours to 3 hours after the playbook change.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose.
edits.reason: "Rather than by accident" just restates "on purpose" in negative form.

edits.original: Cybersecurity today is not merely an IT concern; it is a multidimensional discipline
edits.replacement: Cybersecurity today is a multidimensional discipline
edits.reason: The positive half makes the same claim on its own, so the negative half is only a windup.

edits.original: Technical tools cannot succeed in isolation; they require clear policies
edits.reason: Saying the tools require policies, governance and culture already means they cannot succeed alone, so the negative clause adds nothing.
